summary: Published DEB, RPM, AppImage, and Pacman packages from source commit 79b693a5. The release fixes RT-950 Pro Ferrite zone reads by ending READ_MANY cleanly when the radio returns an empty non-advancing answer, and preserves an undecodable Baofeng 5RX S-CODE value for the repair step instead of stopping the write.
